# Copilot Instructions for WellOff

This file provides instructions for GitHub Copilot when working in this repository.

## Repository Overview

WellOff is a project repository. When contributing to this project, please follow the guidelines below.

## General Guidelines

- Write clear, readable, and maintainable code
- Follow existing code patterns and conventions in the repository
- Include appropriate error handling
- Write meaningful commit messages

## Code Style

- Use consistent indentation and formatting
- Add comments to explain complex logic
- Use descriptive variable and function names

## Testing

- Write tests for new functionality when test infrastructure exists
- Ensure existing tests pass before submitting changes

## Documentation

- Update documentation when making changes that affect usage
- Keep README.md up to date with relevant project information
